mapper.select:
SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqSpclaMapper.selectSpclaList : 특별관리대상자 게시글목록*/ A.CLIENA_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(MAX(A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT)) AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 내담자명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(MAX(S2.FLNM_ENCPT)) AS CONSTT_NM /* 상담원명 */ , TO_CHAR(MAX(A.FRST_REG_DT),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /* 등록날짜 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT /* 전체건수 */ , COUNT(*) AS CMNT_CNT /* 댓글갯수 */ FROM AYB110 A , SAA200 S1 , SCA100 S2
WHERE 1=1 AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = S1.USER_ID AND S1.ENFSN_NO = S2.ENFSN_NO AND (A.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR A.DEL_YN IS NULL)
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(S2.FLNM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN S2.FLNM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(S2.FLNM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{CONSTT_NM} || '%'
GROUP BY A.CLIENA_ID ORDER BY MAX(A.FRST_REG_DT) DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqSpclaMapper.selectSpclaDetail : 특별관리대상자 게시글상세*/ AA.SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_SN , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT , AA.CLIENA_ID , AA.CNSLTNT_ID , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR , AA.DSCSN_DTL_CN , C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CONSTT_NM FROM AYB110 AA , SCA100 BB , SAA200 CC WHERE 1=1 AND CC.USER_ID = AA.CNSLTNT_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = BB.ENFSN_NO AND AA.CLIENA_ID = #{CLIENA_ID} AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) ORDER BY AA.FRST_REG_DT ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT AYB110_SQ01.CURRVAL AS SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_SN FROM DUAL
INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqSpclaMapper.insertSpcla : 특별관리대상자 게시글등록*/ INTO AYB110 ( SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_SN , CLIENA_ID , CLIENA_NM_ENCPT , DSCSN_DTL_CN , CNSLTNT_ID , CNTN_IP_ADDR , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( AYB110_SQ01.NEXTVAL /* 게시글번호 */ , #{CLIENA_ID} /* 내담자아이디 */ , C##RG.ENC_B64(#{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT}) /* 내담자명 */ , #{DSCSN_DTL_CN} /* 상담내용 */ , #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담자아이디 */ , #{CNTN_IP_ADDR} /* 내담자아이피 */ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqSpclaMapper.deleteSpcla : 특별관리대상자 게시글삭제*/ AYB110 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_SN = #{SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_SN}
UPDATE AYB200 SET CLIENA_NM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{CLIENA_NM}) WHERE CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO}
